-- Step 2: Add baseline blocking reasons for credits as specified in EA-153 task -- These are the 5 blocking reasons required for the baseline: -- 1. Fallecimiento (Death) - Priority 1 -- 2. Acelerado - Cobro Juridico (Accelerated - Legal Collection) - Priority 2 -- 3. Acelerado (Accelerated) - Priority 3 -- 4. Castigo - Fraude (Punishment - Fraud) - Priority 4 -- 5. Castigo (Punishment) - Priority 5
